## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

## Hollinger Game Score

The Hollinger Game Score is a single-game impact metric. The standard formula is:

$$
	ext{Game Score} = \text{PTS} + 0.4\cdot\text{FG} - 0.7\cdot\text{FGA} - 0.4\cdot(\text{FTA}-\text{FT}) + 0.7\cdot\text{ORB} + 0.3\cdot\text{DRB} + \text{STL} + 0.7\cdot\text{AST} + 0.7\cdot\text{BLK} - 0.4\cdot\text{PF} - \text{TOV}
$$

```{r visual3, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gganimate)
library(ggimage)

# 1. Load data
df <- read.csv('basketball.csv')
labels_df <- read.csv('player_photos/labels.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  select(player_name, image_path)

# 1b. Hollinger Game Score (using per-game averages)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    game_score = avg_points +
      (0.4 * avg_field_goals) -
      (0.7 * avg_field_goal_attempts) -
      (0.4 * (avg_free_throw_attempts - avg_free_throws)) +
      (0.7 * avg_offensive_rb) +
      (0.3 * avg_defensive_rb) +
      avg_steals +
      (0.7 * avg_assists) +
      (0.7 * avg_blocks) -
      (0.4 * avg_personal_fouls) -
      avg_turnovers
  )

# 2. Filter & Prepare Hollinger Game Score Steps
bench_data <- df %>%
  filter(!starter, games_played > 5) %>%
  drop_na(
    avg_points,
    avg_field_goals,
    avg_field_goal_attempts,
    avg_free_throw_attempts,
    avg_free_throws,
    avg_offensive_rb,
    avg_defensive_rb,
    avg_steals,
    avg_assists,
    avg_blocks,
    avg_personal_fouls,
    avg_turnovers
  )

# 3. Scaling Function
normalize <- function(x) {
  if(max(x) == min(x)) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
}

# 4. Build Hollinger Cumulative Stages (reuse previous stage)
bench_scored <- bench_data %>%
  mutate(
    score_s1 = avg_points,
    score_s2 = score_s1 + (0.4 * avg_field_goals),
    score_s3 = score_s2 - (0.7 * avg_field_goal_attempts),
    score_s4 = score_s3 - (0.4 * (avg_free_throw_attempts - avg_free_throws)),
    score_s5 = score_s4 + (0.7 * avg_offensive_rb),
    score_s6 = score_s5 + (0.3 * avg_defensive_rb),
    score_s7 = score_s6 + avg_steals,
    score_s8 = score_s7 + (0.7 * avg_assists),
    score_s9 = score_s8 + (0.7 * avg_blocks),
    score_s10 = score_s9 - (0.4 * avg_personal_fouls),
    score_s11 = score_s10 - avg_turnovers
  )

s1 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s1, stage = "1. Points (PTS)")
s2 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s2, stage = "2. + Field Goals (FG)")
s3 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s3, stage = "3. - FG Attempts (FGA)")
s4 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s4, stage = "4. - FT Misses (FTA-FT)")
s5 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s5, stage = "5. + Offensive Rebounds (ORB)")
s6 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s6, stage = "6. + Defensive Rebounds (DRB)")
s7 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s7, stage = "7. + Steals (STL)")
s8 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s8, stage = "8. + Assists (AST)")
s9 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s9, stage = "9. + Blocks (BLK)")
s10 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s10, stage = "10. - Personal Fouls (PF)")
s11 <- bench_scored %>% mutate(score_raw = score_s11, stage = "11. - Turnovers (TOV)")

animation_data <- bind_rows(s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9, s10, s11) %>%
  mutate(
    stage = factor(
      stage,
      levels = c(
        "1. Points (PTS)",
        "2. + Field Goals (FG)",
        "3. - FG Attempts (FGA)",
        "4. - FT Misses (FTA-FT)",
        "5. + Offensive Rebounds (ORB)",
        "6. + Defensive Rebounds (DRB)",
        "7. + Steals (STL)",
        "8. + Assists (AST)",
        "9. + Blocks (BLK)",
        "10. - Personal Fouls (PF)",
        "11. - Turnovers (TOV)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(score = score_raw) %>%
  # IMPORTANT: player_name is the tie-breaker. This prevents the order(ind) error.
  group_by(stage) %>%
  arrange(desc(score_raw), player_name) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number() * 1.0) %>%
  filter(rank <= 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(labels_df, by = "player_name") %>%
  mutate(
    image_path_resized = file.path("player_photos", basename(image_path)),
    image_path_final = if_else(file.exists(image_path_resized), image_path_resized, image_path)
  )

# 6. Plotting with Object Permanence
# We use geom_tile because it is more stable than geom_col for "races"
NAME_Y <- -0.05
IMAGE_Y <- 0
IMAGE_SIZE <- 0.06
IMAGE_TIP_OFFSET <- 0.2
p <- ggplot(animation_data, aes(group = player_name)) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = rank, y = score/2, height = score, width = 0.9, fill = score), alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_image(
    aes(x = rank, y = pmax(score - IMAGE_TIP_OFFSET, IMAGE_TIP_OFFSET), image = image_path_final),
    size = IMAGE_SIZE,
    angle = 0
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(x = rank, y = NAME_Y, label = player_name), hjust = -0.1, size = 5, color = "white", fontface = "bold", angle = 0) +
  # Add the numeric score as a label at the tip of the bar
  geom_text(aes(x = rank, y = score, label = round(score, 2)), hjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", direction = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 6, 1, 1, "cm")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "WNBA Hidden Gems: {closest_state}",
    subtitle = "Cumulative Impact Score (Raw)",
    x = "",
    y = "Score"
  ) +
  transition_states(stage, transition_length = 4, state_length = 2, wrap = FALSE) +
  ease_aes("cubic-in-out")

# 7. Render
animate(p, nframes = 11, fps = 1, width = 850, height = 550, renderer = gifski_renderer())

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
